rationale: EO 9674 (January 4, 1946) created a Director of Liquidation and a Liquidation Advisory Committee in the Office for Emergency Management to further the winding up of the war agencies. It has no own-terms sunset. EO 9744 of June 27, 1946 provides that the office of the Director of Liquidation and the Liquidation Advisory Committee, established by Executive Order No. 9674, together with their functions, "are hereby terminated", and states that it becomes effective on June 30, 1946. The status is NO: the bodies and every function the order gave them were terminated effective June 30, 1946, and no held source revives them.
